title: The Hidden Giant
narration: Everything you’ve known—planets, asteroids, people—is point one four% of the solar system. The Sun owns ninety-nine point eight six%. So what is that ball of fire?
visual_goal: Sunrise over Earth, zoom to Sun's surface.

title: Journey to the Core
narration: Surface: five thousand five hundred°C. Core: fifteen million°C. Spans one point three nine million kilometers. The outer atmosphere is a million times hotter—still unexplained.
visual_goal: Cutaway from surface to core showing temperature contrast.

title: The Ancient Engine
narration: For four point six billion years, the Sun fused hydrogen (seventy-three% of mass), releasing three point eight×ten^twenty-six watts every second—enough to power billions of stars.
visual_goal: Composition diagram, then flares and energy waves.

title: Touch the Corona
narration: In two thousand twenty-one, a spacecraft flew through the Sun’s million-degree corona and survived. The Sun spins once every twenty-seven days—visible via sunspots.
visual_goal: Parker Solar Probe near corona glow.

title: Your Star
narration: In ~five billion years, the Sun becomes a red giant, engulfing Mercury, Venus—maybe Earth. For now, one hundred forty-nine point six million kilometers away, it fuels our days. The next solar maximum may change how we live.
visual_goal: Star to red giant, then quiet Sun over Earth.
